findings.text: There is no `requirements.md` in the task folder. The only one is `item-read/requirements.md`, which briefs the child task (the `read` parameter in `Servex/agents/page_tools.js`), and `review/diff.patch` touches none of that. The round-6 header/tabs/settings ask exists only as the "Changing today" bullets in `public/live/readme.md:74-80`. Write the owner's round-6 ask into `requirements.md` as numbered items, in the owner's words, so the work can be checked against it.

The diff is not in the tree I reviewed. `grep` finds 0 hits for `Tabs`, `tabs_of` and `settings_of` in `public/live/LivePage.js`, and `public/live/readme.md:58` and `:74-80` still carry the old text ("Saved screens" in the footer, "Changing today (round 6)"). Commit `429985390` ("keep compliance/dev's live readme") may have dropped it, or it was never landed; `git status` shows only `public/live/page.jsonl` staged. Re-apply and land `LivePage.js`, `LivePage.css` and `readme.md`, then record the commit in the session record.

`public/live/LivePage.test.mjs` is not in the diff, so `title_of`, `tabs_of`, the `settings` route and the `tab_skip` set have no test. These are pure async functions over a listing and are easy to cover.

`LivePage.js` (the diff's `Tabs.render`, around line 233) adds `add` and `remove` listeners to `top.screens` on every Tabs instance and never removes them. The `ResizeObserver` is never disconnected either. Navigating between pages inside the single-page app stacks listeners, and each one calls `draw()` on a detached view. Unbind them when the view is destroyed, or have one shared listener redraw the current Tabs.

`title_of` (`LivePage.js`, diff line ~115) caches a failed fetch forever. A transient `fetch` failure or a listing that hasn't loaded yet caches the folder name for the rest of the load, so tab labels would keep disagreeing with the h1, which is the "one title everywhere" ask. Also, a title set later by `item({path, delta:{title}})` never updates an open tab or preview card because the Map is never invalidated. Don't cache a null result, and drop the entry when the page's own title changes.

The new "Settings" route shadows any card or sub-page named `settings` (`route()` in the diff, line ~95). The readme admits this, but `tab_skip` and `settings` are hard-coded, so a folder `/live/settings/` would silently disappear from the tabs. Give the real folder or screen priority: the check order in `route()` puts `settings` before screens, and `super.route` runs first only for folders.

The other docs that still describe the footer's "Pages here" and "Saved screens" are not in the diff. `public/live/doc/page-features.md` and `doc/notes.md` are the likely ones. Grep them and fix them when item 2 lands, so a fresh agent isn't told about a footer that no longer exists.

The header sets `margin-top: -.75rem` to cancel the page padding, in `LivePage.css:~28`. That is a magic number tied to the `.live-page` padding, so it breaks silently if the padding changes. A `--live-pad` variable shared by both would be safer.

The `shots/` folder has `live-400-light.png`, `nav-top-400.png`, `r4-lab-400.png` and others, but there is no `layout.json` or sheet for the header. The "under 100 px at every depth and width" claim is therefore unmeasured. I did not check the shots against it.
